items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: one non-Claude call, PR-body block with changed/checked/verdict/gap, never blocks, iterate only; measure bars reported honestly in the P4 MEASURE file, operator bar pending

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: every failure (no key, provider down, bad JSON, crash, Claude-family model) becomes a not_run record; tool exits 0; incomplete replies are rejected

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: free text only through files and a one-pass template; model text rendered inert (no markup, no @-mention); prompt-injection can at worst flip an advisory verdict

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 29 tests: parsing, block, trimming, never-raises, exit 0, git working-tree diff, record check, replay event reader

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: one call per iterate; diff capped at 400k chars by whole files

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: pure core in lib, thin CLI, replay tool, one verifier mirroring the P1/P3 checks

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: ai-gap-check.json producer (tool) and consumer (verifier) round-trip tested; model reply boundary tested with fakes and live in the replay
